import os,re
d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n')
G={}
for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
    k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
    rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
    if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
        G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
print(sorted(G))
I=G['Demo pair 1 input']; O=G['Demo pair 1 output']
h,w=len(I),len(I[0])
# find separator rows/cols (all bg=1)
bg=1
srow=[i for i in range(h) if all(v==bg for v in I[i])]
scol=[j for j in range(w) if all(I[i][j]==bg for i in range(h))]
print("sep rows",srow)
print("sep cols",scol)
# markers: non-bg, non-9 cells
for i in range(h):
    for j in range(w):
        if I[i][j] not in (bg,9): print("marker",i,j,I[i][j])
print("out",O)

src=open('/tmp/none','w')  # placeholder
prog='''def transform(grid):
    grid=[list(r) for r in grid]
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    linec=grid[0][0]
    lr=[i for i in range(h) if all(v!=9 for v in grid[i])]
    lc=[j for j in range(w) if all(grid[i][j]!=9 for i in range(h))]
    markers={(i,j):grid[i][j] for i in lr for j in lc if grid[i][j] not in (linec,9)}
    ri={v:k for k,v in enumerate(lr)}; ci={v:k for k,v in enumerate(lc)}
    rmin=min(ri[i] for i,j in markers); rmax=max(ri[i] for i,j in markers)
    cmin=min(ci[j] for i,j in markers); cmax=max(ci[j] for i,j in markers)
    out=[[9]*(cmax-cmin) for _ in range(rmax-rmin)]
    colors=set(markers.values())
    for col in colors:
        pts=[(i,j) for (i,j),v in markers.items() if v==col]
        rows=sorted(set(i for i,j in pts))
        for r1,r2 in zip(rows,rows[1:]):
            if ri[r2]-ri[r1]!=1: continue
            s=sorted({j for i,j in pts if i==r1} & {j for i,j in pts if i==r2})
            bandrow=ri[r1]-rmin
            for j1,j2 in zip(s,s[1:]):
                out[bandrow][ci[j1]-cmin]=col
    return out
'''
